topics.title: BBC plans to close two TV channels
topics.summary: The BBC says BBC Three and BBC Scotland will close as broadcast channels next year as it seeks £500m in savings, while their programming will continue online.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a favorite channel moves online, does it still feel like the same place? What old-school TV ritual would you happily bring back for one night?

topics.title: Japan launches Phobos sample mission
topics.summary: Japan has launched a mission to collect material from Phobos, Mars's larger moon. Scientists hope the samples could reveal clues about the solar system and life on Earth.
topics.discussionPrompt: If you could request one tiny souvenir from space, would you choose moon dust, a Mars pebble, a photo, or something completely impractical?

topics.title: Westminster Abbey sarcophagus mystery revisited
topics.summary: An archaeologist says a Roman sarcophagus at Westminster Abbey likely holds an 11th-century abbot, offering a new explanation for the coffin's long-debated identity.
topics.discussionPrompt: A mystery box beneath a famous building sounds like the start of a great story. What harmless historical surprise would you hope it contained?

topics.title: Arctic town adapts to fast warming
topics.summary: Longyearbyen in Norway's Svalbard archipelago is confronting melting glaciers and thawing permafrost that affect water, housing and landslide risks.
topics.discussionPrompt: What is one everyday invention you think would make life easier in a place with extreme weather: better boots, smarter homes, indoor gardens, or something else?

topics.title: UN urges steeper emissions cuts
topics.summary: The UN says global emissions need to fall 18% within four years to help prevent a dangerous overshoot of climate targets, sharpening the focus on near-term action.
topics.discussionPrompt: What small change feels genuinely doable to you: wasting less food, walking more, fixing things, sharing tools, or growing something?

topics.title: UK inflation rises to 3.5%
topics.summary: UK annual inflation rose to 3.5% in September, more than expected, with fuel prices among the factors pushing everyday costs higher.
topics.discussionPrompt: When prices creep up, what is the first ordinary thing people seem to notice: groceries, fuel, takeout, subscriptions, or the mysterious cost of snacks?

topics.title: Beatles museum plans Liverpool expansion
topics.summary: Liverpool's Beatles Story museum is set to move into a much larger home in 2028, with plans including new exhibits and a Yellow Submarine-themed makeover.
topics.discussionPrompt: If you designed a museum for one band, game, show, or hobby, what absurdly fun exhibit would visitors absolutely have to try?

topics.title: Documentary draws packed cinema crowds
topics.summary: UK cinemas report strong demand for You Can See Everything, a documentary about Elizabeth Holmes, after its notable opening weekend in the United States.
topics.discussionPrompt: What makes a documentary irresistible to you: a strange true story, behind-the-scenes access, a mystery, a big idea, or a recommendation from a friend?

topics.title: South Africa and Australia contest Test match
topics.summary: South Africa and Australia are in the fourth day of their second men's cricket Test, with Australia facing a demanding recovery in Gqeberha.
topics.discussionPrompt: For a long match or a long movie, are you the person who loves the slow build, skips to highlights, or keeps snacks ready for the dramatic finish?

topics.title: Storm Austen heads toward southern UK
topics.summary: A yellow weather warning is in place as Storm Austen is forecast to bring gusts up to 60mph to southern parts of the UK.
topics.discussionPrompt: What is your ideal storm-day setup: a window seat, a board game, a comfort meal, a good playlist, or making sure every phone is charged?
